desc: Read input: H, W, X, P, Q, and the grid S.
Initialize a 2D array dp of size HxW with -1 (or a very small number), and set dp[P][Q] = S[P][Q].
Create a priority queue (min-heap for negative strength) and push (-S[P][Q], P, Q).
Create a visited 2D boolean array of size HxW, initially all false.
Define 8 directions: [(dr,dc) for dr in (-1,0,1) for dc in (-1,0,1) if not (dr==0 and dc==0)].
While the priority queue is not empty:
Pop the cell with the highest strength.
For each neighbor, if not visited and condition met, update strength, mark visited, push to heap, and update global_max.
